# LAMMPS Input Script for NPT Quenching of SiO2

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p
read_data       /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style      tersoff
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SiO2.tersoff Si O

# Define settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    delay 5

timestep        0.001

# NPT Quenching
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press vol density

fix             1 all npt temp 5000.0 1500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000

# Output
dump            1 all custom 1000 dump.sio2 id type x y z
